notes:
Top-level summary: Evaluating Redwood Hosted API for rapid pilot; pivoting toward Dedicated for production due to data residency and predictable throughput needs. CRM-style timeline and notes below.

Timeline:
- 2025-09-12: Lead created via webinar signup (initial AEs assigned Jordan). Quick qualify: mid-market PM tool, heavy embeddings use.
- 2025-10-04: Intro call (Jordan + Priya) — scope: product search & support agent prototype. Agreed to POC on Hosted API.
- 2025-11-02: Demo of Hosted API (SE deep-dive). Positive on latency but flagged multi-tenant cost and residency concerns.
- 2025-11-15: 30-day POC started on Hosted API (embeddings + rerank). Fireflies call ff_2025-11-15_2234.
- 2025-12-10: POC metric review — embeddings quality good; cost per token higher than target at scale.
- 2026-01-08: Architecture review — operations prefer Dedicated to control throughput, egress, and KMS integration.
- 2026-01-20: Pricing discussion — Redwood provided Dedicated pricing bands and commit tiers; ProductFlow inclined to commit 2-3 year reserved capacity.
- 2026-02-04: Legal intake — ProductFlow procurement sent MSA/DPA redlines (standard enterprise asks: liability cap, data residency, subcontractor disclosure).
- 2026-02-10: Legal sync w/ Redwood (Jordan + Redwood legal) — reviewed redlines, initial pushback on indemnity and SLA credit formula. Fireflies ff_2026-02-10_8475b1.
- 2026-02-18: Internal exec meeting at ProductFlow — greenlight to proceed if DPA residency and KMS can be satisfied and SLA >= 99.9% with clear credits.

Use-case details / requirements (from product/infra teams):
- Workload: embeddings (search + rerank) + chat-based support assistant. Peak qps: 150-300 embeddings queries/sec; target latency embeddings <= 120ms tail.
- Throughput target: consistent throughput for batch re-indexing windows (thundering herd protection desired).
- Cost sensitivity: high; looking for 20-30% unit cost reduction vs hosted during steady state (motivating Dedicated).
- Model: prefer Llama 2 or similar open models; open to Redwood-curated quantized variants.
- Routing/fallback: need policy for fallback to smaller model if Dedicated capacity constrained; also region fallback to eu for EU customers.

Security & procurement asks:
- SSO / SAML integration mandatory.
- DPA with data residency clause: EU customer data must remain in eu region GPUs.
- KMS/HSM key control for encryption of customer data at rest.
- SOC2 + ISO27001 requested; Redwood provided SOC2 report link (ok but need vendor onboarding checklist).
- Vendor onboarding: procurement requires procurement questionnaire, proof of insurance, and a security FAQ (links below).

Legal/procurement status & next actions:
- Current status: In procurement. ProductFlow sent MSA/DPA redlines. Redwood legal provided counter-redlines 2026-02-17.
- Open legal points: indemnity, liability cap tied to fees, DPA residency specifics (EU carve-out language), SLA credits calculation and measurement method (agent vs infra), subcontractor disclosure for cloud infra.
- Next planned steps: Legal 1:1 review with ProductFlow legal (2026-02-25). Procurement to run vendor onboarding (docs due 2026-03-05).
- POC/Tech validation: SE Priya to deliver Dedicated performance runbook + KMS integration plan by 2026-02-28.
- Finance: draft SOW showing ARR commitment and discount tiers to be finalized after legal clears MSA.

Quotes/highlights from stakeholders:
- "We liked Hosted for speed of test, but Dedicated is non-negotiable for production due to residency and predictable cost." — Head of Infra (ProductFlow)
- "Need explicit SLA math; credits must be automated and visible in Console." — VP Product

Risks/Concerns:
- Legal may push for higher liability caps than Redwood policy allows; could delay signing.
- KMS timeline: internal security requires HSM-backed KMS; integration engineering effort unclear.
- Cost: committed ARR needs to justify migration and onboarding costs.

Quick wins:
- Provide a redline comparison doc for ProductFlow legal to speed negotiations.
- Early access to Dedicated performance benchmarks tailored to ProductFlow's QPS profile.
- Draft vendor onboarding packet (insurance, SOC2, security FAQ) pre-populated to reduce procurement friction.
